description: We are developing the SphereX challenge for our 4th participation in the Space Apps Challenge. We intend to build the interactive star map with the ability to locate and categorize various stars.
summary: We are developing an interactive star map using data from the SphereX probe. We intend this project to provide a simple and intuitive resource that aids scientists and volunteers working in astronomy and astrophysics.
details:
Eon is an interactive astronomical platform designed to make the exploration and visualization of SPHEREx telescope data easier and more accessible. The platform consists of  a 3D celestial sphere that allows users to find specific regions of the sky.

In order to find the region the user looks for, Eon uses Right Ascension (RA) and Declination (DEC) as coordinates. To simplify this process, Eon provides the INCON coordinate converter that allows inputs in the H:M:S (Hour, Minute, Second), D:M:S (Degree, ArcMinute, ArcSecond) format.

Besides locating astronomical objects, Eon offers a set of various tools which include image manipulation, zooming in, drawing lines, and choosing various spectral scans provided by SPHEREx telescope. Eon aims to provide an accessible and practical platform for locating, visualizing and studying astronomical objects and their corresponding data.
